text:
jon: quick q — our incoming SWE Liwei is on a J-1 at time of offer, and the immigration counsel says a waiver filing is needed before H-1b/onsite work. can people-ops confirm options for start date and benefits? :thinking_face:
maria: thanks for flagging. do we have DS-2019 end date and whether 212(e) applies? also any estimate when waiver gets approved?
liwei: hi all — my DS-2019 ends 2026-07-15. counsel filed the waiver intake last week, they said a DS-3035 receipt exists but still waiting on case number. i can share docs privately.
claire: hi team, clair(e) here from counsel. confirm: waiver type = NO OBJECTION / govt. processing is variable; earliest reasonable estimate 3-6 months, can be faster depending on embassy. currently no guaranteed timeline.
maria: OK. payroll/legal constraints: we cannot put someone on Redwood payroll unless they have valid US work authorization on day 1 (I-9 requirement). we also can't enroll someone in company-paid benefits before active payroll record exists, per benefits vendor.
jon: bummer. what are alternatives if waiver not done by proposed start 2026-05-01? could Liwei start remotely as a contractor or on a consulting agreement?
claire: contractors still need legal permission to be paid for US work. if Liwei will be physically in the US, they need authorization to work. If they remain outside US, they could onboard as a contractor but we need a written contractor agreement and export-control check.
liwei: i'd prefer to start remotely from my home country for a few months if that's easier. would that let me access docs/trainings?
maria: remote-from-abroad option is possible for onboarding tasks and trainings that are non-work-product (internal orientation, docs, repo walkthroughs). but we must be careful about what counts as work. we'll coordinate with legal to define allowed activities.
jon: ok good. what about benefits timing? there's open-enroll deadline coming up in 2 weeks and healthcare effective date matters.
maria: benefits note: new hire enrollment window opens on your payroll effective date. if we delay payroll because waiver isn't approved, health coverage won't kick in until your employment start date. we can provisionally reserve your benefit election but vendor requires employee record.
payroll-bot: FYI — if hire_on_date is after 2026-05-15, new hire benefits effective date = first day of month following hire date per vendor SLA.
claire: actionable next steps from counsel perspective:
```
- Liwei: share DS-3035 receipt number + copy of DS-2019 (redact nonessential PII) to maria privately
- Counsel: confirm waiver intake status and provide estimated case number within 7 business days
- People-ops: hold provisional offer with start_as_contingent on waiver; outline remote onboarding dos/don'ts
- Payroll: confirm contractor pay process & taxes if Liwei chooses to be contractor from abroad
```
maria: will do. jon — can you confirm whether the team can accept a delayed in-person start if needed? also are there onboarding tasks the team is comfortable having Liwei do remotely (non-billable)?
jon: yes team can delay onsite until cleared. remote low-risk onboarding (reading docs, meetings, code walkthroughs) is fine. no production access until cleared. :white_check_mark:
liwei: thanks — i'll send the DS-3035 receipt to maria now. one more Q: will visa docs impact equity vesting start date?
maria: equity vesting uses official hire date on payroll. if payroll start shifts, equity cliff and vesting schedule will align to the payroll start. we can discuss exception scenarios with people ops but it's standard to anchor to payroll date.
claire: also want to flag travel/consular timeline: if waiver requires consular processing, that may add weeks. we'll update timeline when case number arrives.
maria: uploaded a short checklist for Liwei — I'll DM the copy but pasting summary here:
```
Required items (summary):
- DS-2019 (current), DS-3035 receipt number
- Passport photo page
- Any past I-94s / U.S. entry docs
- Signed offer letter copy
- Remote onboarding preference confirmation
- Target onsite start window (if waiver granted)
```
jon: perfect. thanks everyone. please tag me in updates.
liwei: got it — sending docs now. really appreciate the flexibility. :pray:
maria: noted. i'll open a private ticket in our HRIS with Liwei and link counsel thread. expect an email from me with next steps and permissions list by EOD tomorrow.
claire: will follow up with intake confirmation within 3 business days.
payroll-bot: recorded provisional hire state = "pending_work_auth". no payroll action until confirmed.
jon: great, closing loop for now. ping if anything urgent. :wave:
